note: Run covering 2026-08-13 -> 2026-08-14, executed 14:05 UTC Friday, 35 minutes into the US session. 12 lines appended (10 dailies incl. sentinel, 2 trade_events). SEVEN FILLS TO AUDIT after a zero-trade day, and ALL SEVEN PASS: congress's six Rohit Khanna buys first appear in commit 2026-08-13T18:43:21Z (14:43 ET, in hours) with every price inside that day's Yahoo range, and the hype bot's NET sale first appears 2026-08-14T13:36:59Z (09:36 ET, six minutes after the open) at 328.06 against a 322.44-331.83 range. No SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT, and this time the pass is real rather than vacuous. STALENESS CLEAN: all nine states within 18.0-18.6 minutes. The day's substance is that the owner shipped Track A at 01:45Z and it closed three of my four open faults inside one commit - the hype bot's unfirable exit, the Analyst's stale-verdict misreporting, and the swallow-and-continue behaviour that let 225 JSONDecodeErrors report green. The 12:04Z 'failure' is the third of those working: state_preflight caught a git conflict in data/ and aborted the loop RED instead of trading on poisoned state. It cost 90 minutes of darkness, which is the honest price of fail-loud at 6% cron acceptance.
driver_note: 'unknown' took four entries today and I want that on the record as a choice, not a gap. Congress lost 0.44% on a day SPY gained 0.07% with the damage in AVGO -3.98% and ADBE -2.99%; a search surfaced an SK Hynix HBM story that would have explained it neatly, and I refused it because NVDA rose 0.28% and MSFT rose 0.21% on the same tape - a sector story that spares the sector's largest names is not a sector story. Commodity, hunter and the NET fade got the same treatment for the same reason: no dated catalyst, so no invented one. 'technical' takes one entry and it is a fair one - meanrev's UNH bounced after three lower closes, which is literally its z-score thesis, and it beat SPY doing it. The mark timing matters for reading every equity line today: the fleet's 08-14 marks were taken at 13:36Z, six minutes into the session, so the printed day moves are overnight gaps plus six minutes and the sub-0.1% ones are noise. Crypto is the exception, marked 24/7, and it is the cleanest read on the board: -0.60% against a bench -1.11%, a relative-rank rule doing exactly what it is built to do in a falling complex.
